verification_commands.ac2:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-2: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f backend/app/main.py ] || { echo "FAIL AC-2: not run from the TableQueue repo root (backend/app/main.py missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-2: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p backend/.scratch
out="backend/.scratch/_t24ac2.out"; rm -f "$out"
( cd backend && .venv/Scripts/python.exe - > ../"$out" 2>&1 <<'PY'
import os, subprocess, sys, time

PYENV = ".venv/Scripts/python.exe"
BASE = dict(
    JWT_SECRET="t24ac2-secret-0123456789-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz",
    STAFF_PIN="0000",
    ENV="development",
    TZ="UTC",
)
problems = []

def boot(url):
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.update(BASE)
    env["DATABASE_URL"] = url
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    p = subprocess.run([PYENV, "-c", "import app.database"], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=30)
    return p, time.monotonic() - t0

def check_pg(url, tag):
    try:
        p, dt = boot(url)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        problems.append("%s: import did not fail fast (>= 30s) - the refusal must happen at startup, not on first use" % tag)
        return
    text = (p.stdout or "") + (p.stderr or "")
    low = text.lower()
    if p.returncode == 0:
        problems.append("%s: import app.database SUCCEEDED on %s - a non-sqlite URL must be refused" % (tag, url.split("://")[0]))
        return
    if not ("only sqlite" in low or "sqlite-only" in low):
        problems.append("%s: the error does not state that only SQLite is supported (want 'only SQLite' or 'sqlite-only')" % tag)
    if "database_url" not in low:
        problems.append("%s: the error does not name the DATABASE_URL env var" % tag)
    if "sqlite:///" not in low:
        problems.append("%s: the error carries no actionable 'sqlite:////' direction" % tag)
    if "modulenotfounderror" in low and "psycopg" in low:
        problems.append("%s: the failure is still the opaque ModuleNotFoundError for the psycopg driver, not the actionable startup refusal" % tag)
    print("%s: refused in %.2fs (rc=%d)" % (tag, dt, p.returncode))

check_pg("postgresql+psycopg://tq:***@localhost:5432/tq", "psycopg URL")
check_pg("postgresql+psycopg2://tq:***@localhost:5432/tq", "psycopg2 URL")

p, dt = boot("sqlite:///./test.db")
if p.returncode != 0:
    problems.append("sqlite URL: import app.database FAILED (rc=%d) - the shipped sqlite path must be unchanged: %s" % (p.returncode, ((p.stderr or "") + (p.stdout or ""))[-300:]))
else:
    print("sqlite URL: boots in %.2fs (dialect sqlite, unchanged)" % dt)

p2, _ = boot("postgresql+psycopg://tq:***@localhost:5432/tq")
text2 = (p2.stdout or "") + (p2.stderr or "")
db_src = open("app/database.py", encoding="utf-8").read().lower()
if not any(tok in db_src for tok in ("ensure_sqlite", "sqlite_only", "non_sqlite", "refuse")):
    problems.append("no named guard (reference name ensure_sqlite_only) found in backend/app/database.py")
if p2.returncode != 0:
    seed = subprocess.run(
        [PYENV, "-c", "import app.seed"],
        capture_output=True, text=True,
        env=dict(os.environ, DATABASE_URL="postgresql+psycopg://tq:***@localhost:5432/tq", **BASE),
        timeout=30,
    )
    stext = ((seed.stdout or "") + (seed.stderr or "")).lower()
    if seed.returncode == 0:
        problems.append("import app.seed SUCCEEDED on a postgres URL - the seeder's second engine build (get_engine) is not covered by the guard")
    elif not ("only sqlite" in stext or "sqlite-only" in stext):
        problems.append("import app.seed on a postgres URL fails without the contract message - get_engine is not guarded")
    else:
        print("seeder: import app.seed on a postgres URL is refused with the contract message")

if problems:
    for x in problems:
        print("  " + x)
    sys.exit(1)
print("PROBE_OK")
PY
)
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  cat "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-2: a non-sqlite DATABASE_URL must be refused at startup by a named guard with an actionable error (names DATABASE_URL, states only-SQLite, points at sqlite:////) - probe detail above"
  rm -f "$out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-2: non-sqlite DATABASE_URL (psycopg and psycopg2 spellings) is refused fast at import with the actionable contract error; the seeder's engine build is covered; the sqlite path boots unchanged"
rm -f "$out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
exit 0
verification_commands.ac3:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-3: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f backend/app/database.py ] || { echo "FAIL AC-3: not run from the TableQueue repo root (backend/app/database.py missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-3: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p backend/.scratch
out="backend/.scratch/_t24ac3.out"; rm -f "$out"
backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe - > "$out" 2>&1 <<'PY'
import re, sys

src = open("backend/app/database.py", encoding="utf-8").read()
lines = src.splitlines()
problems = []

guard = re.search(r"def\s+([a-z_][a-z0-9_]*)\(.*\)", src)
has_guard_call = bool(re.search(r"get_backend_name\s*\(\)\s*!=\s*[\"']sqlite[\"']", src)) or bool(
    re.search(r"(ensure_sqlite|sqlite_only|_refuse_non_sqlite|check.*sqlite)", src, re.I)
    and re.search(r"make_url|get_backend_name|dialect_name", src, re.I)
)
if not has_guard_call:
    problems.append("no dialect guard found in backend/app/database.py (want a sqlite-backend check on the URL, e.g. make_url(...).get_backend_name() != 'sqlite', reachable from the module)")

ce = re.search(r"create_engine\((.*?)\)", src, re.S)
if not ce:
    problems.append("create_engine call not found in backend/app/database.py")
else:
    block = ce.group(1)
    m = re.search(r"[\"']?timeout[\"']?\s*:\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)", block)
    if not m:
        problems.append("connect_args no longer binds a 'timeout' key")
    elif re.match(r"^[0-9.]+$", m.group(1)):
        problems.append("the busy timeout is an inline literal %s again - it must stay a named constant (the t19 SQLITE_BUSY_TIMEOUT binding)" % m.group(1))
    else:
        name = m.group(1)
        if not re.search(r"^\s*%s\s*=\s*[0-9]" % re.escape(name), src, re.M):
            problems.append("the timeout binding name %s is not a module-level numeric constant in database.py" % name)

window = "\n".join(lines)
low = window.lower()
if "create_engine" in low:
    idx = low.find("create_engine")
    site = low[max(0, idx - 1500): idx + 500]
    if not re.search(r"sqlite[- ]only|sqlite only|only sqlite", site):
        problems.append("the connect_args binding site carries no note that the sqlite-flavoured args are correct because the URL is enforced sqlite-only (the B-10 premise must be documented where the args are bound)")

if problems:
    for x in problems:
        print("  " + x)
    sys.exit(1)
print("static OK: guard present, timeout is a named constant, sqlite-only premise documented at the binding site")
PY
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  cat "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-3: the B-10 connect_args defect is not retired - the engine build needs a sqlite dialect guard, the named busy-timeout constant, and the sqlite-only premise note at the binding site (detail above)"
  rm -f "$out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-3: connect_args are sqlite-flavoured and correct by enforcement - dialect guard present, timeout is a named constant, the sqlite-only premise is documented at the binding site"
rm -f "$out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
exit 0

  echo "FAIL AC-4: the passed floor shrank below the groom baseline (want >= 344 passed, got $passed)"
  rm -f "$out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache

fi
if ! ( cd backend && .venv/Scripts/ruff.exe check . > ../"$out" 2>&1 ); then

fi

  rm -f "$out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  exit 1
fi

rm -f "$out"; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
exit 0
verification_commands.ac5:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-5: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f backend/app/main.py ] || { echo "FAIL AC-5: not run from the TableQueue repo root (backend/app/main.py missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-5: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p backend/.scratch
out="backend/.scratch/_t24ac5.out"; rm -f "$out"
problems=""
# Arm (a): no PG driver ships.
for mod in psycopg psycopg2; do
  if backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import $mod" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    problems="$problems\n  arm (a): the $mod module imports in the suite venv - a PG driver ships, option B adds none"
  fi
done
# Arm (b): the doc surface makes no PG boot promise (same grep set as AC-1).
if grep -qiE "no code changes needed" _docs/deployment.md || grep -qE "^#+.*Future PostgreSQL" _docs/deployment.md; then
  problems="$problems\n  arm (b): _docs/deployment.md still carries the PG boot promise (Future PostgreSQL heading / no code changes needed)"
fi
if grep -qiE "postgres|psycopg" README.md _docs/SETUP.md _docs/QUICKSTART.md _docs/config.md docs/config.yaml docs/config.yaml.example docs/config_reference.md 2>/dev/null; then
  problems="$problems\n  arm (b): a live doc still contains a postgres/psycopg string"
fi
# Arm (c): a non-sqlite URL is refused fast at import with the AC-2 contract.
( cd backend && DATABASE_URL="postgresql+psycopg://tq:***@localhost:5432/tq" JWT_SECRET="t24ac5-secret-0123456789-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" STAFF_PIN=0000 ENV=development TZ=UTC .venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import app.database" > ../backend/.scratch/_t24ac5_c.log 2>&1 )
rc=$?
cat backend/.scratch/_t24ac5_c.log > "$out"
low=$(tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' < "$out")
if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then
  problems="$problems\n  arm (c): import app.database SUCCEEDED on a postgres URL"
else
  case "$low" in *"only sqlite"*|*"sqlite-only"*) : ;; *) problems="$problems\n  arm (c): the refusal does not state that only SQLite is supported" ;; esac
  case "$low" in *database_url*) : ;; *) problems="$problems\n  arm (c): the refusal does not name DATABASE_URL" ;; esac
  case "$low" in *"sqlite:///"*) : ;; *) problems="$problems\n  arm (c): the refusal carries no actionable sqlite://// direction" ;; esac
fi
if [ -n "$problems" ]; then
  printf "%b\n" "$problems"
  echo "FAIL AC-5: the fresh-clone invariant is not observable - no PG driver (a), no PG doc promise (b), and a fast actionable refusal of a non-sqlite URL (c) must all hold (detail above)"
  rm -f "$out" backend/.scratch/_t24ac5_c.log; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-5: fresh-clone invariant holds - no PG driver ships, no live doc promises a PG boot, and a non-sqlite DATABASE_URL is refused fast at import with the actionable contract error"
rm -f "$out" backend/.scratch/_t24ac5_c.log; rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null; rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
